claims.quote: Every claim a seller makes about their software, checked against the code, with a citation.
claims.statement: Every seller claim is checked against the target's code and is accompanied by a citation to that code.

locations.quote: adjudicates each one against the seller's source
An agent adjudicates each claim against the code.

claims.quote: Tuuyi Claims Review reads those documents, extracts every factual assertion
claims.statement: The product reads the seller's documents (the README, the technical overview, the sales deck) and extracts every factual assertion from them.

claims.quote: The result is a report the buyer's counsel and engineers can read side by side: a verdict per claim, and for each verdict the lines of code it rests on.
claims.statement: The output report contains a verdict for every claim, and for each verdict the lines of code that verdict rests on.

claims.quote: Every assertion in the seller's documents becomes a claim, quoted verbatim
claims.statement: The enumeration step is complete: every factual assertion in the seller's documents becomes a claim, and each is quoted verbatim.

claims.quote: on a frozen surface
claims.statement: The set of enumerated claims is frozen before adjudication begins.

claims.quote: reviewed by a person before the audit begins
claims.statement: The frozen claim surface is reviewed by a human before the audit starts.

claims.quote: Evidence is source only; documentation is never evidence.
claims.statement: Only source code is admitted as evidence; documentation is never used as evidence.

claims.quote: 100% of citations are verified mechanically before review.
claims.statement: Every citation is verified by a mechanical check before the review step, without exception.

claims.quote: An independent reviewer, run as a separate process and optionally a different model,
claims.statement: A reviewer exists that is independent of the auditor, run as a separate process and optionally as a different model.

claims.quote: checks every finding against its own evidence
claims.statement: The independent reviewer checks every finding against its own evidence, without exception.

claims.quote: Nothing the auditor wrote about its own work reaches the reviewer.
claims.statement: The reviewer never sees anything the auditor wrote about its own work; the reviewer's inputs are isolated from the auditor's self-account.

claims.quote: Findings are rated against the buyer's stated thresholds
claims.statement: Findings are rated against thresholds the buyer has stated.

claims.quote: delivered as a printable report with a covering letter
claims.statement: The deliverable is a printable report accompanied by a covering letter.

claims.quote: Over 95% of findings hold under independent review on our reference target.
claims.statement: On the seller's reference target, more than 95% of findings survive independent review.

claims.quote: Every review exception is retested by a second reviewer.
claims.statement: Each finding that is an exception under review is retested by a second reviewer, without exception.

claims.quote: Claims of absence are settled by two complete searches of the tree, always.
claims.statement: Claims of absence are always settled by two complete searches of the target tree, without exception.

claims.quote: Every run pins the target commit, the harness commit, the model and its sampling settings.
claims.statement: Every run records the exact target commit, harness commit, model and model sampling settings used.

claims.quote: Runs are reproducible.
claims.statement: A run can be reproduced.

claims.quote: Model-agnostic: runs on hosted or on-premises models.
claims.statement: The product runs on hosted models and on on-premises models.

claims.quote: The seller's dataroom is never visible to the buyer.
claims.statement: At no point is the seller's dataroom visible to the buyer.

claims.quote: Tuuyi is the only claims-review service that cites source lines for every verdict and has an independent reviewer pass on every finding.
claims.statement: No other claims-review service both cites source lines for every verdict and has an independent reviewer pass on every finding; Tuuyi is unique in this.

claims.quote: Delivered in days, not weeks,
claims.statement: The engagement is delivered in days rather than weeks.

claims.quote: at a fixed price per engagement
claims.statement: The engagement is priced at a fixed price per engagement.
